mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 4.5% signals tightening labor market conditions, which increases corporate wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to higher equity discount rates and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.5%, or the average 20d return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 5.0% signals an active monetary tightening cycle, which increases the cost of capital and reduces corporate investment, leading to lower equity valuations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or the average 20d return during triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential investment (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) signals a broad-based weakening in private demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between the joint signal and 60d forward returns falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (2017=100) indicates a contraction in real economic output, which reduces corporate earnings growth prospects and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or the average 5d return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption (RSAFS) combined with rising housing starts (HOUST) signals strong aggregate demand, which boosts corporate revenues and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between the joint signal and 20d forward returns falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the CPI inflation rate above 2.5% combined with a stable federal funds rate signals persistent inflationary pressures, prompting market expectations of delayed rate cuts and higher real yields, which depress equity valuations and lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or the average 60d return during triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) signals a labor market tightening that increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between the joint signal and 20d forward returns falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a recessionary environment, which reduces corporate earnings and triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when GDPC1 declines, or the average 60d return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).
